$comment: TRANSCRIBED from plugins/config_swap_probe/config_swap_probe_keys.h + _io.h. config_swap_probe is a reference SOURCE for the orchestrator config-swap design: its process() has no data contract, so its surface is its CONFIG ({value}), one exchange COMMAND (get_status), and the STATUS object that command returns. The status-reply object is a bespoke extractor OUTSIDE the constrained typed-field family the generator emits, so this decl sets "handwritten_io": true — the generator owns the KEY contract (_keys.gen.h) but config_swap_probe_io.h stays hand-written (see the codegen-gap note in docs/new_gen/08 and contract/codegen/README.md). The status field key names are listed under "outputs" ONLY so collect_keys mints their k-constants; a source's outputs never become schema slots or TS/Py types.
title: config_swap_probe — orchestrator config-swap reference (config + get_status).
